secondary_contrasts: Aab+ contrasts; no assumption that Aab+ is a clinical disease stage
multiplicity: BH across ten slots; unavailable tests retain a slot and no fabricated p-value
covariates: log section area unless area is the exposure
spatial_primary: non-overlapping, geometrically valid, assessable tissue-clipped regions; 20 um band

hypotheses.title: Size-dependent endocrine preservation
hypotheses.test: Disease by within-donor log section-area interaction for insulin-positive endocrine fraction
hypotheses.endpoint: Ins_any / (cells_total - Triple_Neg), the union of INS/GCG/SST positivity from the source QuPath export

hypotheses.title: Innervation
hypotheses.test: Disease by compartment interaction for nerve area fraction, adjusted for size
hypotheses.endpoint: peri minus core nerve-positive area fraction

hypotheses.title: Vascularization
hypotheses.test: Disease by compartment interaction for capillary area fraction, adjusted for size
hypotheses.endpoint: peri minus core capillary-positive area fraction

hypotheses.title: Lymphatic–immune association
hypotheses.test: Within-donor lymphatic area fraction association with CD45-positive counts and log area offset

hypotheses.title: Neurovascular coupling
hypotheses.test: T1D versus ND excess nerve proximity to capillaries within 20 um under compartment-constrained spatial nulls, adjusting for area and densities

hypotheses.title: Cytotoxic-cell access
hypotheses.test: Within-donor association of core CD3e+/CD8a+ density and insulin-positive endocrine fraction

hypotheses.title: Basement-membrane organization
hypotheses.test: ColIV boundary coverage association with the fraction of nearby CD45-positive cells inside core

hypotheses.title: Ductal–stromal niches
hypotheses.test: Within-donor distance to validated CK19/panCK duct association with insulin-positive endocrine fraction

hypotheses.title: Islet heterogeneity
hypotheses.test: T1D versus ND donor-level dispersion of size-adjusted endocrine-cell profiles

hypotheses.title: Added microenvironment information
hypotheses.test: Nested donor-held-out balanced accuracy improvement of full regularized profile over demographics, size and endocrine composition; permute donor labels through the whole procedure
hypotheses.markers: all 31 plus structural densities and spatial summaries

followups.rule: If H1 and H2/H3 have q<0.05, test size by implicated structural density; choose smaller q, capillary on tie. Otherwise test H1 adjusted for both densities.
If H4 has q<0.05, omnibus lymphatic-neighborhood enrichment of CD8, CD4, B and macrophage-associated subsets; otherwise peri versus distant lymphatic localization.

If H7 and H8 have q<0.05, test duct distance by ColIV coverage; if only one, its disease interaction; if neither, report unsupported mechanism and uncertainty. Missing tests cannot establish non-support.

If H9/H10 yield stable features, test an INS-independent signature against held-out insulin-positive tissue burden, then secondary C-peptide association; otherwise prespecified size plus structural density signature.

followup_family: exploratory same-cohort; independent replication requires new donors
pseudotime_family: separate BH family; full-cohort descriptive curves are not inferential tests
